item.title: Frantic 911 call from hero dad who killed school shooter released
item.description: The armed father who was hailed for his heroic actions​ during a deadly shooting​ at his daughters' elementary school in Oregon frantically called authorities before he went after the shooter.

item.title: Americans vote in battle for Senate and House control— live updates
item.description: Control of Congress and the fate of President Trump's legislative agenda are now in the hands of American voters, who are heading to the polls to decide the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Attorney and Trump foe targeted in Alaska ballot probe, sources say
item.description: Marc Elias, a longtime Democratic attorney and vocal opponent of the Trump administration, received one of about 20 target letters sent by the DOJ in its Alaska ballot investigation.

item.title: Iran dismisses U.S. response to peace proposal as "not convincing"
item.description: Trump said on eve of U.S. elections that a deal with Iran "could happen," but after new U.S. strikes, Tehran called America's response to the latest proposal "not convincing."

item.title: Westchester County ballot scanners down at some midterm election sites in New York
item.description: Some ballot scanners at polling sites in Westchester County, New York, are down, officials said. CBS News' Shannelle Kaul has more.

item.title: Chris Pappas makes final pitch to New Hampshire voters
item.description: Democratic candidate Chris Pappas made his final pitch to New Hampshire voters as polls opened on Tuesday morning. CBS News' Jared Ochacher has more.

item.title: NYC marathoner died from rare condition rhabdomyolysis, father says
item.description: Rhabdomyolysis is a rare condition that can occur after very intense exercise or be triggered by drugs.

item.title: Supreme Court seems likely to favor Catholic schools in pre-K fight
item.description: The Supreme Court is weighing a case involving Catholic preschools' efforts to participate in Colorado's universal preschool program.

item.title: Tennessee murderer captured over a week after escaping prison
item.description: Jacob Morley was serving a life sentence at the Northwest Correctional Complex in Tennessee when he escaped by slipping through a fence on the property.

item.title: How Wall Street analysts think the midterms could affect stocks
item.description: Despite the political drama surrounding U.S. elections, stocks have historically risen following midterms, market data shows.

item.title: New Jersey's governor warns ports against accepting Russian diesel
item.description: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill said ports and terminal operators receiving shipments of Russian diesel could face criminal penalties.

item.title: Oklahoma man charged with mailing hundreds of white-powder letters
item.description: An Oklahoma man faces federal charges after allegedly sending hundreds of letters containing white powder to public officials and media outlets ahead of the 2024 and 2026 elections.

item.title: DOJ sending 1,000 monitors to polling sites is an "intimidation tactic," voting advocate says
item.description: President Trump's Department of Justice deployed a record number of election monitors to polling sites across the U.S. Democracy Forward President Skye Perryman speaks about the importance of voting and democracy.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will stop sending $4 billion yearly military assistance to Israel by end of year
item.description: President Trump suggested that the U.S. will bring its funding for Israel to a close in a recent interview. CBS News' Nicole Sganga reports.

item.title: Poland launches major security operation along border with Russia
item.description: Poland's prime minister says a rapid, major deployment of extra security forces to the border with Russia may have prevented "attempted acts of provocation."

item.title: Here's when polls close for 2026 midterm elections today
item.description: If you are in line to cast your ballot before a polling site closes, you have the right to remain in line and vote.

item.title: Soaking rain to start the week in Minnesota; colder days ahead
item.description: Scattered showers continue Tuesday, with the steadiest rain west and north of the Twin Cities. Highs are expected in the 60s, and more showers move through Tuesday night into Wednesday.

item.title: Trump's Iran war, high gas prices and affordability issues are impacting midterm voters
item.description: President Trump shared some mixed messaging on Iran ahead of the midterm elections. This comes as the war's economic consequences weigh heavily on many. CBS News' Nicole Sganga has more.

item.title: Analyzing Alaska, Texas Senate races
item.description: Alaska's Senate race garnered attention with Democrat Mary Peltola and two Dan Sullivans on the ballot. In typically red Texas, Republican Ken Paxton faces off against Democrat James Talarico. CBS News' Fin Gómez has more.

item.title: Bodycam video shows moments after National Guard fatally shot man
item.description: Tennessee prosecutors released video of National Guard troops pointing their handguns at a man as he lay dying on a Memphis sidewalk last summer after a guard member shot him in the back.

item.title: Cruise canceled after Coast Guard detains ship in Miami, officials say
item.description: MSC Cruises canceled the voyage for its MSC Poesia cruise ship after it was detained by the Coast Guard at the Port of Miami, the cruise line confirmed to CBS News.

item.title: Election cybersecurity explained
item.description: Many ballot scanners are down across New York's Westchester County, officials say. However, voters can still vote, as emergency backup procedures are in place. CBS News legal expert Chris Krebs has more on election security and technology.

item.title: "Dexter: Resurrection" stars on playing serial killer hunters
item.description: Dominic Fumusa and David Zayas, who both star as detectives on "Dexter: Resurrection," talk about how they got their acting starts and about playing serial killer hunters in the hit series.

item.title: Child dies of measles in New York for first time in 30 years
item.description: For the first time in 30 years, a child in New York died of measles, which comes amid outbreaks in 45 states and Washington, D.C., according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Dr. Céline Gounder joins with more.

item.title: Binance customers withdraw $7.42 billion after crypto heist
item.description: Binance said the net outflow from the cryptocurrency exchange represents just 3% of its total holdings.

item.title: Top races to watch on Election Day
item.description: Election Day is underway, and CBS News' Aaron Navarro, Adriana Diaz and Skyler Henry have team coverage on closely watched races in Michigan, Texas and Georgia.

item.title: The Awkward Money Talk Every Friend Group Needs | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
item.description: Traveling with friends anytime soon? You might want to have "the money talk" before hand… In this episode, Jill and Mark are breaking down the must-have conversations you should have before you plan your group travel. Plus, callers Anna and Nick are suffering from burnout—what's next?

item.title: How to watch live election results on CBS News
item.description: With control of Congress on the line in House and Senate races around the country, here's how to watch the 2026 midterm election results on Tuesday, Nov. 3.

item.title: Best pet insurance companies of 2026
item.description: Pet insurance premiums jumped by double digits last year. We priced the best pet insurance to see who's worth it.

item.title: Cops: Macy's security guard led shoplifting ring
item.description: Police reportedly arrested guard at Macy's in Boston suburb where he worked, allegedly trying to steal $7K in merchandise
